GENERAL SCIENCE — MOCK EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: GENERAL SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any substance that conducts electricity
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

   C. Petrol fires have no fuel

   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

13. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)

14. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
